references.text: The Spirit of the Lord came upon Othniel, and he became a judge in Israel. This shows the same pattern where the Spirit of the Lord equips a person to carry out God's work.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Gideon and gave him strength to lead Israel. The same expression is used for the coming of the Spirit upon the judges.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah, showing the same pattern of the Spirit's equipping among the judges.
The Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson. This is the first mention of the Spirit's work in Samson's life, which continues in chapter 14.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Samson again, and he struck down thirty men. The same expression and pattern as in verse 6.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Samson with power, and he broke his bonds. Shows a repeated pattern of supernatural strength through the Spirit.
The Spirit of God came upon Saul with power. The same Hebrew expression is used for the powerful work of the Spirit.
The Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard about the distress. A parallel to the coming of the Spirit upon the judges.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward. Shows the continuity in the Spirit's equipping of God's chosen leaders.
The prophecy concerning the Messiah over whom the Spirit of the Lord will rest. Shows the ultimate fulfillment of the Spirit's equipping.
